purpose: Pass8 focused same-font joined-vowel challenge at eight remaining Sirach positions; exact literal proposals only.
canonicalApplicationState: Report author made no canonical edits. SIR remains byte-identical to the pass8 baseline; root integrates approved proposals separately.
scope: Only annotated chapters were reviewed. Nearby material on those same source pages supplies font controls. Exploratory31:3 also belongs to an annotated chapter and was rejected as a positive control. No new PSIK exports or translations were used.
sourcePolicy: Only fresh original embedded primary/companion pixels, native crops and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements. No OCR, grammar-based supplied points, normalization, filtering, reconstruction or another translation. Physical connectivity alone does not decide readability: full geometry must discriminate against ordinary feet and competing vowel forms.

decisions.unitTextBefore: בַּמֶּה שֶׁהרְשֵׁיתָ הִתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֵין לְךָ עֵסֶק בַּנִּסְתָּרוֹת׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: בַּמֶּה שֶׁהֻרְשֵׁיתָ הִתְבּוֹנֵן וְאֵין לְךָ עֵסֶק בַּנִּסְתָּרוֹת׃
decisions.finding: The he has three fully detached stamps descending diagonally down/right. The same-page kaf in printed3:21 ומכסה has the identical three-point diagonal; the full source words and primary context verify the target. Only qubbuts U+05BB is supplied.

independentApproval.basis: Exact target, complete word, source-address context and discriminating positive/plain/counter controls independently viewed before approval.

decisions.finding: The two detached right-hand stamps coexist with a lower-left lobe connected to the long qof diagonal foot. A sheva with an irregular natural foot and a segol with its left point fused into that foot remain indistinguishable. Plain final qof in חלק shows a tapered foot, but the analogous בחקך crop is itself not an independently secure pointed control and cannot choose the vowel from canonical spelling. Retain unknown.

decisions.unitTextBefore: מִשָׁוכֵן זָרִיז זְהִיר דַּרְכֶּךָ וינַכֶּרךָ בְּמַחֲמַדֶּיךָ׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: מִשָׁוכֵן זָרִיז זְהִיר דַּרְכֶּךָ וינַכֶּרְךָ בְּמַחֲמַדֶּיךָ׃
decisions.finding: Two vertically stacked stamps occur below the normal resh shaft end. Their placement and shape match the resh sheva in the very same printed34 row דרכך, whereas bare final resh in זהיר stops above both stamp levels. The companion resolves the upper lobe against the saturated primary. Only resh sheva U+05B0 is supplied; the initial-vav uncertainty remains.

independentApproval.basis: Exact target, complete word, source-address context and discriminating positive/plain/counter controls independently viewed before approval.

decisions.unitTextBefore: בִּשְׂפָתָיו יִתְמַהְמַהּ צָר וּבְלִבּוֹ יַחְשֹׁב מהָמַרוֹת עֲמֻקּוֹת׃ וְגַם אִם־בְּעֵינָיו יַדְמִיעַ אוֹיֵב אִם־מָצָא עֵת לֹא יִשְׂבַּע דָּם׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: בִּשְׂפָתָיו יִתְמַהְמַהּ צָר וּבְלִבּוֹ יַחְשֹׁב מַהָמַרוֹת עֲמֻקּוֹת׃ וְגַם אִם־בְּעֵינָיו יַדְמִיעַ אוֹיֵב אִם־מָצָא עֵת לֹא יִשְׂבַּע דָּם׃
decisions.finding: A detached broad continuous shallow bar lies below the first mem. Its flat lower edge and shallow lugs match the yod patah in the same printed16 row יחשוב; same-row tav qamats in בשפתיו has a deep descending stem. The paired tsere in עת has a central white division, unlike the continuous target bar. That comparator is printed17, the second half of the present Catholic12:16 unit. Only first-mem patah U+05B7 is supplied.

independentApproval.basis: Exact target, complete word, source-address context and discriminating positive/plain/counter controls independently viewed before approval.

decisions.finding: The isolated upper-left tip may be holam or a broken natural bet ascender; no control uniquely separates these. Same-row bare bet in בערבה has a continuous upper tick. The apparent בושת positive is confounded by the next shin dot, and the exploratory31:3 לקבל sample does not independently certify the assumed upper point. No lower vowel is unambiguously readable. Retain unknown.

The target resh foot has a small continuous irregular hook. The same-row bare resh in עושר shows an uneven shaft/foot and even small ink breaks, so apparent extra low ink is not uniquely a vowel. Neither companion nor saturated primary separates a diagnostic mark. Retain unknown.

decisions.unitTextBefore: וְכִלְבוֹנָה תִּתְּנוּ רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ וְנֵץ תָּנֵצוּ כְּשׁוֹשָׁן׃ תְּנוּ רֵיחַ וְאִמְרוּ שִׁיר בּרכוּ יְיָ עַל־כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים׃ הָבוּ גֹדֶל לִשְׁמוֹ וְהוֹדוּ לוֹ בִּתְהִלָּה׃
decisions.unitTextAfterProposed: וְכִלְבוֹנָה תִּתְּנוּ רֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ וְנֵץ תָּנֵצוּ כְּשׁוֹשָׁן׃ תְּנוּ רֵיחַ וְאִמְרוּ שִׁיר בּרְכוּ יְיָ עַל־כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים׃ הָבוּ גֹדֶל לִשְׁמוֹ וְהוֹדוּ לוֹ בִּתְהִלָּה׃
decisions.finding: Two entirely detached vertically stacked stamps appear to the right and below an already visible broad ordinary resh foot. The same-row bare final resh in שיר has only the shaft/foot; the same-font pointed resh control from11:34 supports the added stamp placement. Only resh sheva U+05B0 is supplied; the bet-vowel uncertainty remains.

independentApproval.basis: Exact target, complete word, source-address context and discriminating positive/plain/counter controls independently viewed before approval.

decisions.finding: A broad lower resh foot is continuous with its shaft. Local bare final resh in שקר establishes the ordinary end height but does not uniquely distinguish an enlarged natural foot from an attached point at the target. No separate complete dot/bar arrangement discriminates the vowel. Retain unknown.

preservationContract: Insert exactly one certified vowel scalar per approved target; preserve every pre-existing scalar in relative order.
Retire only four explicitly approved note IDs. Keep all other note records, updating anchors only where the approved literal changes their shared word.
Preserve every consonant, existing vowel, punctuation mark, bracket, gap, witness, block, chapter/verse sequence and Catholic ordering decision.
SIR11:34 is a previously pinned Catholic chapter-return unit; root must refresh its exact unit hash without altering the return decision or order.
Do not reinterpret ambiguous existing points in comparison words or correct them opportunistically.
